description: Two moving sound sources heard from two listening points: the distance to each source sets a delay and a level, and changing the distance shifts the pitch the way a passing siren does.

params.text: How much the first source is heard at the second listening point.
How much the second source is heard at the first listening point.
How much the first source is heard at its own listening point.
How much the second source is heard at its own listening point.
Cutoff of the low pass filter on the first path.
Cutoff of the low pass filter on the second path.
Chooses where the low pass filters are placed: up they act on the doppler paths, middle on the outputs, down on both.

inputs.text: Audio for the first source. With nothing patched here an internal sine is used instead.
Audio for the second source. With nothing patched here an internal sine is used instead.

outputs.text: What reaches the second listening point.
What reaches the first listening point.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
The module makes a sound with nothing patched in, because each empty audio input is replaced by an internal sine.
